correctness.rationale: The exact PMF telescopes through \(G_k\), so the lattice survival is \(1-G_k\). The source's asymptotic \(u_k\sim\theta^k/(\lambda k)\) gives the survival and PMF equivalents, hence the exact PGF/MGF convergence boundary by the root test. The corrected raw moments follow from the nonnegative tail-sum identity and Tonelli's theorem. The source's Eq. (6.4) has summand \(\sim-rk^{r-1}\), proving divergence without numerical assumptions. The standalone checker reproduces the tail constants and direct-versus-tail moment agreement.

value.rationale: Moments, skewness, kurtosis, actuarial tail risk, and heavy-tail flexibility are major advertised properties of the new distribution. The finding corrects the raw-moment formulas at their foundation, gives the exact transform domain, and shows that a named heavy-tail simulation regime is asymptotically light. These corrections directly affect mathematical interpretation while preserving the possibility of finite-range high-kurtosis fits.
